- **Frontend**: Next.js 14, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, Progressive Web Apps (PWA)

## Shipped Systems & Open-Source Projects

- **Viya AI** (https://heyviya.vercel.app): Multilingual conversational life and wealth partner supporting personal finance, budgeting, and stock analytics in 5 Indian languages (English, Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Kannada) across PWA, WhatsApp, and Android. Stack: Python, FastAPI, LangChain, Gemini, Supabase, n8n, Whisper.
- **SmartDetect** (https://github.com/Lokii1211/Smart-Detect): Enterprise real-time multi-camera person detection, tracking, and face-anchored Re-ID platform with 5-stage identity arbitration cascade (YOLOv8n, ByteTrack, InsightFace ArcFace 512-d, OSNet x1.0, Face-Anchor principle) and DPDP/GDPR biometric data governance. Stack: Python 3.12, FastAPI, PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector, React 18, Vite.
- **Kaizy** (https://kaizyy.vercel.app): India's workforce OS connecting homeowners with verified skilled workers across 35 categories with 3-round geo-dispatch and Razorpay escrow payments. Stack: Next.js 14, TypeScript, Supabase, Mapbox GL, Razorpay.
- **Mentixy** (https://synaptiqq.vercel.app): AI career intelligence platform with Claude AI counseling, Judge0 live coding arena, and CareerDNA 256-dim vector profiling in pgvector. Stack: Next.js 14, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Claude AI, pgvector, Redis.
- **KadaiGPT** (https://github.com/Lokii1211/kadaigpt): WhatsApp-first smart shop assistant for Indian kiranas with bilingual Tamil/English NLP, automated GST invoicing, and real-time inventory management. Stack: Python, FastAPI, LangChain, Gemini, PostgreSQL, React PWA.
- **AadhaarAnalytics 360**: UIDAI National Data Hackathon 2026 project leading analysis of 4.94M+ Aadhaar records with 9 interactive data dashboards. Stack: Python, NumPy, Pandas, Plotly.
